known_issues.issue: Slot door lock not engaging / door stuck
known_issues.probable_cause: Solenoid lock misalignment and dust in latch
Local transformer overloading; voltage dips below 360V

incident_history.symptoms: Rider unable to close slot 5 door after inserting battery; swap could not complete
incident_history.root_cause: Latch bracket loosened, solenoid plunger not aligned with strike plate
incident_history.resolution: Realigned and tightened latch bracket, cleaned latch with contact cleaner, applied dry PTFE lubricant, tested 20 open/close cycles

incident_history.symptoms: Station stuck in 'Updating' state, swaps blocked
incident_history.root_cause: OTA package partially downloaded (connectivity dropped at 63%)
incident_history.resolution: Triggered rollback to STN-FW 4.2.5 from NOC console, station back online. OTA rescheduled for off-peak window (2 AM) over Wi-Fi backup

incident_history.symptoms: Main contactor tripped 3 times in one evening, all slots stopped charging
incident_history.root_cause: Supply voltage dipping to 342V during evening peak
incident_history.resolution: Enabled under-voltage auto-recovery with 120s delay in station config; raised complaint with DISCOM (ref MSEDCL-PN-55821) for transformer upgrade; servo stabiliser proposal raised
